purpose: Summative evidence integrating C2.1, C2.2, C2.3.
student_learning_goal: I can tell a balance story about something in real life and write the equation.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can tell a balance story about something in real life and write the equation.
header.character_watermark: Bella and Bobby together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.student_instructions: Title your story. Then write 1-2 sentences about it.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Title slot and lined writing area.

image_placeholders.description: A title slot 'My Story Title: ___' with a lined writing area below in B&W line-art. Total ~7in × 2in. 4-5 dotted writing lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_STORY_BOX: keywords (story, title) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any 1-2 sentence story with a clear quantity comparison.

parts.student_instructions: Draw the balance scale. Label what's on each pan.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. A blank balance scale drawing area.

image_placeholders.description: A blank balance scale drawing area in B&W line-art, ~7in × 3in. The two pans are pre-drawn with thin outlines but empty. The pivot is in the middle with a small triangle base. Children fill in what's on each pan.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_BALANCE_BOX: keywords (balance, scale) name what the area asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any balance drawing with both pans labeled with quantities matching the story.

parts.student_instructions: Write the equation that matches your story. Use = or ≠.

image_placeholders.description: A single equation line in B&W line-art, ~7in × 0.7in. Format: '___ ___ ___ ___ ___' (5 blanks for the equation).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_EQUATION: keywords (equation) name what the line asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any equation matching the story.

parts.student_instructions: Write ONE more way to express the same total.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. A single expression line.

image_placeholders.description: A single expression line in B&W line-art, ~7in × 0.7in. Format: '___ = ___ ___ ___'. Header: 'Another way to make the total!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_EQUIVALENT: keywords (equivalent) name what the line asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any equivalent expression for the same total as the story.

parts.student_instructions: Read Bella's balance story. Bella has 4 stickers. Bobby has 5 stickers. Together they have 8. Is Bella's balance correct? Circle YES or NO. If NO, write the equation that would balance.
parts.visual_layout: Story text in a speech bubble from Bella's avatar at the top of the section. Two YES/NO option circles below. Below that, a single equation line with three blanks: ___ + ___ = ___ for the corrected balance.
parts.answer_key: NO. The correct balance is 4 + 5 = 9 (or 4 + 4 = 8 if the goal is to make Bella's claim about the total of 8 hold). Accept either as long as the child shows reasoning.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a SECOND equivalent expression for your total.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone summative worksheet. Use as the integrated evidence for C2.1+C2.2+C2.3. Watch for children who write a story but no balance/equation — flag for the structure reteach.
